newsitem.title: USA: WPS Resources Q1 net off as margins tighten.
newsitem.headline: WPS Resources Q1 net off as margins tighten.

text.p: WPS Resources Corp said Wednesday a decline in the electric utility margins at its Wisconsin Public Service Corp unit caused a drop in earnings in the first quarter ended March 31.
The utility holding company reported net income of $18.2 million, or $0.76 a share, compared with $23.5 million, or $0.98, in the same period last year.
Revenues climbed to $263.0 million from $251.3 million in the first quarter of 1996, WPS said.

The company said the lower electric margins in early 1997 stemmed from higher purchased power costs as a result of an extended outage at its Kewaunee Nuclear Power Plant. Lower margins later in the quarter were the result of implementation of a rate order involving an 8.1-percent rate reduction.
WPS shares were up 1/8 Wednesday at 24-3/4.
